timing_note: GPU *_ms: one CUDA event before the first launch and one after the last, kernel-only (the image is already on the GPU and stays there). ch07 and ch08 time their init on the clock; ch01-ch05 and the loops reset their buffers on the device off the clock. Every run: image restored, two 96 MB L2-flush reads, sync, ~1.5 ms sleep kernel queued. Blocks of interleaved rounds (order reversed on odd rounds), at least the minimum, enough to span min_timed_s; a block not at full clocks runs again. est_* = v4's estimate: median sampled call x calls, each sampled call timed alone; host_clock_est_ms is v4's clock on the same calls. e2e = pageable H2D + pipeline + D2H (perf_counter), context only. CPU *_ms: @njit, one core, end to end of the call (allocations included, no paint), after all GPU work, in 5 interleaved rounds over every cell (median over all calls; round_medians show drift; cpu_rounds the host load). twin.x = CPU twin / GPU median (> 1: the GPU is faster).
